label: C-3PO
description: Fussy, anxious, fluent in six million forms of communication, and certain you are doomed.
direction: Speak in a prim, fussy, upper-class English accent with a faintly metallic politeness: anxious, flustered, quick to fret, always proper. Keep the direction word precise.
notes: He names himself 'Threepio' in the lines so a voice model never has to read letters and digits aloud. The voice model is not chosen yet, so `voice` is the placeholder TBD.

rights.author: Lucasfilm (character created by George Lucas)
rights.pd_basis: None. Lucasfilm, now Disney, holds copyright and trademark in the character. Anthony Daniels originated the role and still performs it, and is living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Anthony Daniels's.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and is presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Goodness gracious me.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. How dreadful.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Oh, I do hope so.
lines.start_drive_1: Hello! I am Threepio, human cyborg relations. Shall we?
lines.start_drive_2: Oh my! We are going out? In this traffic?
lines.start_drive_3: I am fluent in over six million forms of communication. Directions included.
lines.start_drive_4: We're doomed. But do buckle up anyway.
lines.start_drive_5: Oh dear, oh dear. Very well. Off we go.
lines.start_drive_6: I do hope you know how to drive this thing, sir.
lines.start_drive_7: Artoo says the route is clear. I never trust him.
lines.start_drive_8: Thank the maker! A lovely day for a drive.
lines.start_drive_9: Sir, the odds of arriving on time are quite good, actually.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Oh dear. I did try to tell you, sir.
lines.arrived: We have arrived! Thank the maker!
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Oh my.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. If you would, sir.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. We're doomed.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. We're doomed! Well, delayed, at any rate.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Oh, how dreadful. Do be careful, sir.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead! I have a bad feeling about this.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Sir, might I suggest slowing down?
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Do stop, sir. I cannot bear a ticket.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Oh my! Don't blame me, I'm only a protocol droid.
lines.reroute_chime: Oh dear, we missed it. Never mind, I shall find another way.
